mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(TT.COURSE_ID) FROM COURSE_TIME_TABLE TT INNER JOIN COURSE C ON C.ID = TT.COURSE_ID WHERE TT.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND TT.DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TT.DATETIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(C.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(C.END_DATED)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTENDANCE (ID , LGN_DT , ATTEND_STATUS , USER_ID , COURSE_ID) VALUES ('AD-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_ATTENDANCE_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') , SYSDATE , CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') <= #{lateTime} THEN 'Y' WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') <= #{absentTime} THEN 'L' ELSE 'N' END , #{userId} , #{courseId})
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(LGN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ATTEND_DATE , ATTEND_STATUS , TO_CHAR(LGN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LGN_DT FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND LGN_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND LGN_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
